quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Does the speaker still expect things to improve?
quests.explanation: The speaker has accepted that nothing will change and simply adjusts. Everything points to resignation.
quests.textToSpeak: The elevator's broken again. Fine, six floors. It's not like anyone's going to fix it this month.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Focus on what the speaker says they'd take right now.
quests.explanation: The speaker's body is exhausted and rest is the one thing they want. That's what the clues add up to: tiredness.
quests.textToSpeak: Twelve hours on my feet, and the bus is late. If somebody offered me a mattress right here on the sidewalk, I'd take it.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Notice how little resistance the speaker shows.
quests.explanation: The speaker doesn't complain. They accept the inconvenience as something they can't change. Everything points to resignation.
quests.textToSpeak: They're rebuilding the road again. Six months of dust and detours. Well. It'll be nice when it's done, I suppose.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Is the danger happening now, or possible later?
quests.explanation: Nothing terrible has happened yet, but the uncertainty leaves the speaker uneasy. Worry is the feeling here.
quests.textToSpeak: The test said 'inconclusive,' so they want to run another one. They're not saying it's serious. They're not saying it isn't.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Notice what the speaker did with their body.
quests.explanation: There was immediate danger and the speaker hid. Fear is the natural reading.
quests.textToSpeak: The ground shook, and then the light fittings started swinging. I dived under the table and stayed there.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Compare how things used to be with how they are now.
quests.explanation: The change makes the speaker concerned about the boy's well-being. Worry is the feeling here.
quests.textToSpeak: He's fifteen, and he's stopped telling me about his day. He used to talk my ear off.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Is the speaker sure about the result, or only encouraged by small progress?
quests.explanation: The speaker sees small improvements but has no guarantee. So hopeful is the best fit.
quests.textToSpeak: It's a long shot, I know. But the last three teams I asked all said 'send us a video.' That's more than I had last month.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Think about what the speaker has achieved and who taught them.
quests.explanation: The speaker completed something meaningful and honors the person who taught them. Everything points to pride.
quests.textToSpeak: Look at those stitches. My grandmother taught me on that old machine, and today I finished my whole first dress.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Notice how quickly the speaker acted and who they told.
quests.explanation: Acting immediately and telling everyone shows energetic enthusiasm. Excitement is the feeling here.
quests.textToSpeak: They just announced the studio tour is open to volunteers. I've already filled in the form and told my whole class.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Ask what the speaker is measuring, and against whom.
quests.explanation: The speaker compares their own position with someone else's better one. Jealousy is the natural reading.
quests.textToSpeak: She's had the same job as me for one year, and she's already got her own office. I noticed that this morning.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Notice who happened to be listening.
quests.explanation: Embarrassment fits because the speaker was seen in an unguarded moment by someone important.
quests.textToSpeak: I was singing along in the car, window down. The whole bus stop heard me, including my boss.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Think about how big the problem is and how the speaker phrases the request.
quests.explanation: The behavior is inconsiderate but minor, and the request is dry rather than furious. That's annoyance.
quests.textToSpeak: Could you not narrate your entire phone call at full volume? Some of us are trying to read.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Is the speaker thanking someone for a favor, or moved by a gesture?
quests.explanation: The silent, thoughtful gesture shows how much the speaker matters to him. This is being touched.
quests.textToSpeak: He didn't say anything when he handed me the box. Inside was the mug I broke years ago, glued back together.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Listen to the speaker's wish at the end of the sentence.
quests.explanation: The speaker wants to thank someone for real help. The speaker is grateful.
quests.textToSpeak: The nurse stayed late to explain everything twice, and she gave me her direct number. I don't know how to thank her enough.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Think about the personal history the speaker brings to the moment.
quests.explanation: The speaker sees their child achieve what they couldn't. Pride is the natural reading.
quests.textToSpeak: Twenty years ago I left school with nothing. Yesterday my daughter got her diploma, and I watched her walk across that stage.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: What is the speaker separated from?
quests.explanation: The speaker hears other people's connection and has none. So lonely is the best fit.
quests.textToSpeak: Everyone in the building has somebody. I hear them laughing through the walls. I eat dinner facing the wall.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Think about what the letter represents for the speaker.
quests.explanation: The letter connects the speaker to someone they've lost. That's what the clues add up to: sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: I found the letter she wrote me the summer before she passed. I've read it four times, and I'm still not done.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Notice the choice the speaker makes at the end.
quests.explanation: The speaker has no energy left and will choose sleep over anything else. That's tiredness.
quests.textToSpeak: Please don't ask me anything complicated. Yes or no. Coffee or bed. I'll pick bed.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Does the speaker want anything more from the day?
quests.explanation: The speaker is at peace with the simple day and needs nothing else. That's contentment.
quests.textToSpeak: Nothing exciting happened today, and I was fine with that. Good soup, a book, and warm socks.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Notice the word 'if' and what depends on it.
quests.explanation: The improvement is real but not certain yet. The speaker looks ahead with hope.
quests.textToSpeak: The fever's down for the first time since Sunday. If it stays down through tonight, she might go back to school on Monday.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: How does the speaker describe the moment and their reaction now?
quests.explanation: The speaker is enjoying the win with clear, lively pleasure. Everything points to happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: We won the school quiz! Everyone cheered, somebody threw a hat in the air, and I'm still grinning.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: How many separate demands has the speaker listed?
quests.explanation: Too many demands landing together make it hard to cope. That's being overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: Group project, two exams, my brother's wedding, and I said yes to volunteering. It's all due the same week.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Is anything actually going wrong?
quests.explanation: Nothing is wrong, but the speaker can't relax. That's what the clues add up to: anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: Everything's on track. I know that. It's just that 'on track' always feels like the moment right before it isn't.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Notice what keeps blocking the speaker's progress.
quests.explanation: Repeated obstacles keep the speaker from finishing something simple. That's frustration.
quests.textToSpeak: I've been trying to update the software since ten. Every update needs another update, and each one takes an hour.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Is the speaker admiring someone's skill or celebrating their own success?
quests.explanation: The speaker admires another person's ability. Being impressed is the feeling here.
quests.textToSpeak: That's the first time I've seen anyone fix the copier in under a minute. And you didn't even read the manual.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Compare what the speaker believed with what they just learned.
quests.explanation: The speaker's assumption was completely wrong. The reaction is surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: Excuse me? You're the new CEO? I thought you were the intern!

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Focus on what the speaker asks for at the end.
quests.explanation: The speaker can't keep the relationships straight and asks for it to be repeated. That's confusion.
quests.textToSpeak: So he's her brother, but also her boss, and also her landlord? Hang on. Start again.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: What did the driver do that he didn't have to do?
quests.explanation: What the speaker highlights is the driver's free, extra kindness, so gratitude is the strongest feeling here, more than the relief of getting home.
quests.textToSpeak: The tow truck driver drove me all the way home, no charge. I'd been stuck on that road for two hours.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Think about who the speaker has to talk to next.
quests.explanation: A plan the speaker was proud of has fallen through. That's disappointment. Nobody is to blame, which rules out anger.
quests.textToSpeak: I'd already told my class we were going. Now the museum has cancelled our trip because of a leak in the roof.

quests.instruction: Listen closely. Which emotion fits the speaker best?
quests.hint: Notice who was watching, and how long the speaker has known her.
quests.explanation: The mistake happened in public and should never have happened. Everything points to embarrassment.
quests.textToSpeak: I forgot her name in the middle of the introduction. In front of her colleagues. I've known her for four years.
